authority_limit: SCXML specifies its state-machine notation and processor semantics, not every enterprise aggregate lifecycle or effect authority.
bounded_claim: SCXML defines event-driven state configurations and legal transitions; absent external processors a conforming machine reacts deterministically to the same input event sequence unless explicitly nondeterministic.

authority_limit: Logical clocks establish ordering properties, not physical occurrence time, business causality or source truth.
bounded_claim: The happened-before relation is a partial order over distributed events; logical clocks can extend ordering but a total tie-break does not turn concurrent events into causally related events.

authority_limit: OWL-Time does not choose application time roles, clock authority, lateness, database recording policy or correction semantics.
bounded_claim: OWL-Time distinguishes instants, intervals, durations and temporal reference systems while leaving application-specific occurrence, validity and recording roles to profiles.

authority_limit: Beam defines its portable dataflow model, not universal business finality, source completeness or acceptance.
bounded_claim: Beam separates boundedness, event-time windows, watermarks, triggers, state and timers; a watermark is a progress estimate rather than proof of source or business finality.

authority_limit: A physical null marker carries no missingness reason, observation mechanism, imputation authority or domain validity.
bounded_claim: Arrow encodes per-slot nullness with validity bitmaps and a null count, while masked value bytes are not semantically meaningful.

authority_limit: XACML decision states do not define all partial-information domains and do not prove enforcement or business truth.
bounded_claim: XACML keeps Permit, Deny, Indeterminate and NotApplicable distinct and makes combining behavior explicit.

authority_limit: Telemetry gaps and staleness markers do not define generic missingness, business measure semantics or analytical completeness.
bounded_claim: OpenTelemetry metrics separates delta/cumulative temporality, observation/start timestamps, stream gaps and an explicit no-recorded-value marker.
